title: Bug 633676: Expense Agent - Setup wizard - Cannot clear default approver once saved from assist edit
summary: The Expense Agent Setup Wizard now allows users to clear the default approver field after it has been saved, fixing a previous restriction that prevented modification.
key_points: Default approver can now be cleared in the setup wizard
Resolves inability to modify the field once saved
Change made to the Expense Agent Setup Wizard page
Enables users to remove previously set approver assignments
Feature requires SaaS environment with Agent framework enabled
